description: Get one UK parliamentary written question with the government's full answer, by its id from written_question_search. Gives the full question and answer text, who asked and who answered, dates, whether it was a holding or corrected answer, and any attachments. Source: UK Parliament Written Questions API. Lookup is by numeric id, not by UIN. (cost: 1 credit)

id.description: int, required, written question id (the id field from written_question_search, not the UIN)

name: written_question_detail
